primary_change: Reduced public analysis choices to three professional construction control packages.

control_packages.Schedule Recovery: Schedule / Delay + Workforce: delay analysis, manpower gap and recovery plan.
control_packages.Cost & Payment Control: Cost Estimate + Progress Payment / F-2: smeta, actual cost, F-2 and payment risk.
control_packages.Full Dashboard: Premium combined dashboard: schedule, workforce, cost, F-2, risk and PDF/Excel reports.

safe_model: Agents report and prepare decisions; production changes require manual approval.
